action.objective: Commit verified Nc5, continuing development and hitting d7 queen while eyeing d4 pawn.
action.rationale: Broad search at depth 3-4 (3000 nodes) identified e4c5 as top candidate with exact score 97, ahead of h4e7 (upper bound 96) and others. Single-candidate verification at max depth 4: safety complete, no immediate mate, no tactical refutation (not_found, 35 nodes). move_facts: Nc5 attacks d7, a4, b7, e4; only immediate opponent capture is Bxd3 (a pawn grab, not winning material). Black's only reply shown was Qd7-c8 retreat per PV. This is the only commit_ready move and it is verified. Nc5 improves piece activity over the passive h4e7 line and avoids the return-home and early-queen penalties.
